name: pull_asset
description:
Copy a desktop-local asset's source file to a path you can read with Read or pass to shell tools (ffmpeg, sox, etc.).

Only works for media assets (video / audio / image / gif) that live as files on this desktop — typically assets added via push_asset from this machine. Code-based assets (motion-graphic / effect / transition / svg) have no file bytes; use inspect_asset with { assetId, includeCode: true } to read the source instead. Cloud-only assets (no local copy on this machine) cannot be pulled — ask the user to re-import the file via push_asset.

Returns the absolute local path where the bytes landed plus size. When outputPath is omitted, this uses the same desktop MCP project workspace as read_script/apply_script.

assetId.description: Asset ID or 10-hex prefix from the project library.

outputPath.description: Optional output path. During an in-chat ACP Agent turn it must stay inside that Agent's project workspace; manually configured desktop MCP clients may pass an absolute path. Parent directories are created if missing.
